changes.title: Clutch
items: A new bag to find: the Clutch, whose far, fast letters pass through up to three creatures in a line

changes.title: Nightie chemise
items: Her nightie is a short white chemise now: thin straps, bare shoulders, a ruffled hem at mid-thigh

changes.title: Bag accuracy
items: The Bumbag, Tote, Duffel and Backpack throw less straight, and the Backpack and Bumbag spread wider the longer you keep throwing
